records.text: Calvin and Dave greeted each other as people who had spoken previously and were meeting again on March 23, 2023.

Dave attended a recent event focused on classic cars, which he described as a car lover's paradise. Dave viewed many classic cars and spoke with several owners about their fascinating stories; the experience was inspiring for Dave.
Calvin reported experiencing a major life change and shared a photo of his new mansion. The photo showed a building with a sign on its front; no readable sign text was provided.
On March 23, 2023, Calvin said he was excited to learn about Japanese culture and have a chance to expand through a major life journey or change.
Calvin expressed fascination with Japanese traditions and eagerness to experience Japanese culture, despite never having been to Japan.
As of March 23, 2023, Calvin had never visited Japan.

On March 23, 2023, Dave congratulated Calvin on his major life change, asked what inspired Calvin to begin the journey, praised learning about new cultures, and asked whether Calvin had visited Japan and when Calvin was leaving.
Calvin plans to travel to Japan in April 2023, stay there for a few months, and then go to Boston.
On March 23, 2023, Calvin shared a photo of the living room in his Japan accommodation; the room contained a couch, a table, and a television.
Calvin's agent found the place where Calvin will stay in Japan, and Calvin expressed gratitude for the accommodation.
During Calvin's trip to Japan, Calvin plans to explore the city, try different local cuisines, and possibly collaborate with musicians in the area.
Dave thought Calvin's Japan accommodation looked cozy and said that having a place to stay was important; Dave also considered collaborating with local musicians an amazing experience.
On March 23, 2023, Dave said he had been spending a lot of time at a beautiful, calming park and shared a photograph of the park showing a lake and a few boats.
On March 23, 2023, Calvin said he had never been to Dave's park but thought it looked like a chill spot and planned to visit it when Calvin returned from his trip to Japan.
On March 23, 2023, Dave wished Calvin an enjoyable trip and offered to provide additional recommendations if Calvin needed them.
On March 23, 2023, Calvin thanked Dave, said Calvin would ask for help if needed, and told Dave to stay safe.

On March 26, 2023, Calvin told Dave that Calvin had bought a new luxury car, fulfilling Calvin's dream of owning a luxury car. Calvin described the car as very smooth and powerful and said driving it made Calvin feel like a rockstar.

On March 25, 2023, Calvin took a newly purchased red sports car for a ride and shared a photo showing the red sports car parked on the side of a road. Calvin said getting into the car gave Calvin an adrenaline rush and felt deserved after hard work.
Calvin has not stated the make, model, or name of Calvin's new car, and Calvin has not clarified whether it is Calvin's first car.
On March 18–19, 2023, Dave attended a music festival in Boston featuring many bands. Dave described the atmosphere as electric and said the festival reminded Dave why Dave loves music.
A shared photo from Dave's music festival showed a large crowd of people at a concert.
On March 26, 2023, Calvin asked Dave which band at the Boston music festival was Dave's favorite; Dave had not answered yet.
Dave's favorite band is Aerosmith, and Dave said Aerosmith's performance at the Boston music festival on March 18–19, 2023 was incredible.
Dave shared a photo of an Aerosmith concert showing a large eagle on the stage.
Dave said he finally saw Aerosmith perform live and described the experience as amazing; Dave did not get to meet or spend time with Aerosmith members after the show.
Dave shared an additional photo from the Aerosmith performance showing two people on stage with guitars and a microphone.
Calvin bought a new red sports car on March 26, 2023 and described it as smooth and powerful.
Calvin wrote new tunes and attended several studio sessions during the week of March 19–25, 2023.
Calvin is excited to collaborate on his new music and looks forward to sharing the results.

Calvin has never been to Japan and is fascinated by Japanese culture. Calvin planned to travel to Japan in April 2023 for a few months, then go to Boston; Calvin's agent found accommodation with a cozy living room. Calvin wants to explore the city, try local cuisines, and possibly collaborate with local musicians. Calvin plans to visit Dave's unnamed calming park with a lake and boats after returning from Japan. On March 26, 2023, Calvin bought a red sports car described as smooth and powerful, shared a photo of it parked roadside, wrote new tunes, and had several studio sessions during March 19–25; Calvin is excited to collaborate. Dave attended a Boston music festival on March 18–19, 2023, chose Aerosmith as his favorite band, shared concert photos including a large eagle on stage and two people with guitars and a microphone, and did not meet Aerosmith after the show.

On April 20, 2023, Calvin attended an awesome music festival in Tokyo, Japan. Calvin did not see any bands there but met many talented artists and music-industry professionals, finding the experience enriching and inspiring.

On April 20, 2023, Calvin said a producer at the Tokyo music festival advised Calvin to stay true to himself and develop a unique sound. This advice made Calvin think about the direction of Calvin's music and motivated Calvin.
Calvin dreams of touring the world, performing for different people, connecting with audiences, reaching a global audience, and making an impact through Calvin's music.
After Calvin finishes the Frank Ocean tour, Calvin plans to travel to Boston, Massachusetts, to explore its music scene. Calvin is excited to visit Boston and hopes to perform there.

Dave plans to show Calvin around Boston, Massachusetts, including cool local spots and music venues. Dave mentioned Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park as places with an excellent music scene, and Dave intends to be in the front row when Calvin performs.
On April 20, 2023, Dave shared a photograph showing a city skyline with a boat on the water; Calvin thought Boston looked great and praised the photograph.
Dave attended a car show in Boston during the weekend of April 15–16, 2023, where he admired classic cars and the dedication involved in restoring them.
Dave is very interested in auto engineering because he finds classic cars charming and admires the work people put into restoring them.
Dave shared a photograph of a green Mustang parked in a grassy field.
Calvin said he had put a lot of work into his car and shared a photograph of a red sports car displayed at a car show.
Dave looks forward to showing Calvin classic cars and other automotive sights when Calvin visits Boston.
Dave asked Calvin whether Calvin had explored Boston beyond attending music gigs.
Calvin plans to explore Boston, try its food, and visit popular attractions after arriving there; Calvin suggested that Calvin and Dave eat together in Boston.
Dave agreed to eat with Calvin in Boston and plans to show Calvin Dave's favorite food spots and other favorite places in the city.
As of April 20, 2023, Calvin had not yet explored Boston because rehearsals and traveling had kept Calvin busy.
Calvin and Dave are enthusiastic about spending time together in Boston, especially trying food and experiencing the city's music and attractions.

Calvin is in Japan as of 2023-04-20, busy with rehearsals and traveling, and has not yet explored Boston. Calvin plans to explore Boston, visit popular attractions, try local food, and eat with Dave. Dave will show Calvin favorite Boston food spots and places, including previously discussed venues and attractions. Calvin dreams of a global music career and plans to go to Boston after finishing the Frank Ocean tour.

On 2023-05-01, Dave told Calvin that Dave had opened his own car maintenance shop, a dream that gave him a dedicated place to work on cars. Dave shared a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front.
On 2023-05-01, Calvin congratulated Dave on opening the car maintenance shop and said Dave’s hard work and dedication had paid off. Calvin shared a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage.
Dave’s car maintenance shop is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars. Dave loves classic cars for their design and engineering.
Dave is obsessed with classic cars and says they have a unique charm.

Dave restored a classic car in 2022 and was thrilled by the restoration. Dave described the restoration as challenging but worthwhile and shared a photo of the restored car’s engine with a small air filter.
On 2023-05-01, Calvin shared a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot while encouraging Dave’s pursuit of his classic-car dreams.
Calvin believes fulfilling dreams is important and praised Dave for having the guts and ambition to pursue his dreams.

Calvin and Dave both value the satisfaction of creating or restoring something from scratch and seeing hard work, dedication, passion, and skills turn it into reality. Dave said this feeling motivates him.
On 2023-05-01, Dave shared a photo of his car maintenance shop showing a group of people standing in front of a car.
Calvin said he would love to visit Dave's car maintenance shop sometime and asked what kinds of cars Dave works on.
Dave's car maintenance shop handles all kinds of cars, including regular maintenance and full restorations of classic cars.
Dave is passionate about working on cars every day and finds the work rewarding. Dave especially enjoys seeing cars transform and feels satisfied helping people keep their cars in good condition.
Calvin praised Dave for doing work he loves while helping others, and said Dave's hard work and talent deserve recognition.
Dave appreciated Calvin's encouragement and said it means a lot that Dave's work is valued and brings joy to others.
Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant and described the necklace as beautiful and stunning.
Calvin received his gold necklace with a diamond pendant as a gift from another artist; Calvin views the necklace as a reminder of why he continues hustling as a musician.
Dave admired Calvin's gold necklace with a diamond pendant and encouraged Calvin to keep pushing and making music.
Calvin and Dave acknowledged that the road can be hard, but remembering their reasons for pursuing their work helps them continue; Calvin proposed that Calvin and Dave keep motivating each other.
On May 3, 2023, Dave began teaming up with a local garage and shared a photo of a car being worked on inside a garage.
On May 3, 2023, Calvin congratulated Dave on the new local-garage venture, called Dave's dedication inspiring, and praised Dave's progress since their previous conversation.

On May 3, 2023, Dave said Dave loved the new job, worked with excellent mechanics, and shared automotive knowledge. Dave shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage and described the project as cool but challenging.
On May 3, 2023, Calvin praised the car Dave was working on, recognized Dave's effort, and asked about Dave's future plans.
Dave plans to continue learning about auto engineering and may someday build a custom car from scratch. In the meantime, Dave plans to continue working on the current project and assisting customers.
Calvin considers Dave inspiring for pursuing the dream of building a custom car and encouraged Dave to relax and enjoy the process.
Calvin relaxes by taking long drives in a car; Calvin enjoys the wind and open road because driving feels freeing and helps clear Calvin's head.
On May 3, 2023, Calvin shared a photo of a red sports car driving down a road while describing long drives as a relaxing hobby.
Dave finds driving with the wind in his hair and walking around while exploring sights and sounds calming and effective for destressing.
As of May 3, 2023, Calvin had been enjoying learning about Japanese culture while remaining in Japan.
On May 3, 2023, Calvin said that his music creativity felt frozen and that he was struggling to come up with musical ideas.
Dave suggested that Calvin immerse himself in things he loves, such as concerts or favorite albums, take a break from music, and explore other activities to restart his inspiration.
On May 3, 2023, Calvin thanked Dave for the advice, agreed that taking a break and exploring could restore his motivation, and said Calvin would follow Dave's suggestion.
On May 3, 2023, Dave encouraged Calvin to keep pursuing music and never give up; Calvin and Dave expressed mutual appreciation and agreed to stay in touch and offer help if needed.
On 2023-05-09, Calvin's place was flooded. Calvin saved his music gear and favorite microphone, but the flooding disrupted his music activities and he needs repairs.
As of 2023-05-16, Calvin is waiting for insurance coverage to begin before starting repairs to his flooded place, and hopes the process will not take long.
On 2023-05-16, Calvin shared a photo of his creative music studio, which contained a keyboard, a synthesizer, and other musical equipment.
On 2023-05-16, Calvin said the flooding had been tough, but he was staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed so he could return to making music.
On 2023-05-16, Dave expressed sympathy about Calvin's flooding, was glad Calvin had saved his music gear and favorite microphone, encouraged Calvin to stay positive, and offered to help.
On 2023-05-16, Dave complimented Calvin's music studio as looking awesome and encouraged Calvin to hang in there while waiting for repairs.
Calvin wants to get back to making music after repairs to his flooded place are completed.

Calvin remains in Japan and is pursuing a global music career after the Frank Ocean tour while dealing with a creative block. On 2023-05-09, Calvin's place was flooded; he saved his music gear and favorite microphone and is waiting for insurance to begin repairs. On 2023-05-16, Calvin shared a photo of his music studio containing a keyboard, synthesizer, and other equipment, and hopes to resume making music after repairs. Dave remains Calvin's supportive friend and offered help. Dave opened a car maintenance shop on 2023-05-01, works with a local garage and mechanics, assists customers, learns auto engineering, dreams of building a custom car, and plans to show Calvin Boston venues and spots.
On May 16, 2023, Dave said he had opened his own car shop the previous week, invited friends to celebrate, and was excited to share his passion and help customers with their vehicles.
On May 16, 2023, Dave said his car shop had been an amazing and incredible experience so far and that he was excited about its future.
On May 16, 2023, Calvin congratulated Dave on opening his car shop, praised Dave's contagious excitement, and encouraged Dave to keep up the great work.
Calvin planned to perform in Tokyo during May 2023, hoping to introduce his music to a new audience and expand his following.
Dave expressed enthusiasm about Calvin's upcoming Tokyo performance, believed the audience would love Calvin's music, wished Calvin luck, and asked Calvin to report how the performance went.
On May 16, 2023, Calvin said he would keep Dave updated about the Tokyo performance and thanked Dave for the good-luck wishes.
On May 16, 2023, Calvin shared a photo showing a city at night with many lights and remarked that it was a wonderful night; the photo's city was not explicitly identified.
Calvin took the previously shared nighttime city photo in Tokyo, Japan, on the night of May 15, 2023; the photo showed a stunning skyline with many bright city lights.
Dave thought Calvin's Tokyo nighttime skyline photo was a great shot and that the city lights made the skyline stand out.
Dave said he wants to take a trip to Tokyo, Japan, soon.
Calvin said the city lights in Tokyo, Japan, are amazing and encouraged Dave to visit Tokyo because it is awesome.
Dave plans to add visiting Tokyo to his travel list.

On 2023-05-31, Calvin told Dave that touring with Frank Ocean during the previous week (approximately 2023-05-22 through 2023-05-28) had been wild, and that performing in Tokyo had been unreal because the crowd was insane. Calvin felt intensely alive while performing and struggled to express the experience.
On 2023-05-31, Dave said he had repaired his neighbor's car engine himself. The shared photo showed a man working on a car engine inside a garage.

Calvin and Dave both find working on cars calming and therapeutic. Calvin said fixing cars helps him chill, clear his head, calm down, and feel a sense of achievement similar to meditation; Dave agreed that helping neighbors with their cars is therapeutic.

Dave is passionate about fixing and transforming things, viewing it as more than a hobby. He enjoys turning nonworking objects into smoothly functioning ones, giving them a second chance, and this creates a sense of achievement, purpose, power, and happiness that motivates him.

Calvin and Dave compared their creative and repair work, agreeing that making something great from nothing or giving something new life through hard work and ideas feels powerful, happy, and deeply rewarding.
Calvin loves performing live. He said live performance fuels his soul, gives him a rush and an indescribable absolute high, and creates a powerful connection with the crowd.

On 2023-05-31, Dave shared a photo showing a large crowd taking pictures at a concert and commented that the atmosphere was off the charts. Calvin shared a photo showing a crowd watching a concert under bright lights. Dave then shared a photo of a band performing on stage.

Dave believes music brings people together, creates a great atmosphere, and can be therapeutic for everyone. Calvin agreed that a live performance feels like one big harmony in which everyone participates.
Calvin is looking forward to touring with Frank Ocean and performing in Boston, where he expects to connect with people from home and experience Boston's music scene.
Dave thinks Boston has an awesome music scene, with many talented musicians and appealing venues for performances.
Dave plans to be in Boston to cheer Calvin on during Calvin's performance.
Calvin appreciates Dave's support and told Dave that it means a lot to him.
Dave looks forward to hearing about Calvin's Boston experience after Calvin returns.
Calvin plans to tell Dave all the details when Calvin gets back and expects to see Dave soon.
On June 8, 2023, Calvin met with the creative team for his album. The session was long but enjoyable, and Calvin was excited to see the album coming together.
Calvin said he and a studio team were creating music and working on everything for his album. Calvin shared a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk.
Dave shared a photo of a pond containing a boat and surrounded by trees.
Dave encouraged Calvin to keep pushing the album, saying that teamwork produces incredible results.
Dave enjoys exploring parks and taking walks on weekends because being surrounded by nature feels peaceful and recharges Dave for the entire upcoming week.
Calvin had never visited Boston as of June 9, 2023, but planned to visit Boston in July 2023 and was eager to experience Boston's parks.
Calvin shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground while discussing Boston parks.
Dave went for a walk in a Boston park on Friday, June 2, 2023, and described the experience as serene and magical.
Calvin wanted to walk in Boston parks to experience serenity and recharge.
Calvin shared a photo of a path ascending a hill with a mountain view.
Dave enjoys hiking because being in nature and challenging himself clears Dave's mind and brings calm, although Dave had not gone hiking recently as of June 9, 2023.
Calvin had never visited the mountains as of June 9, 2023, but was keen to hike in a mountainous place to escape, de-stress, and relax.
Calvin shared a photo of an airplane flying over a snow-capped mountain range.
Dave booked a trip to an unspecified mountainous region for July 2023 and expected to see majestic peaks.
Dave planned to take many photos during the July 2023 mountain trip and show the photos to Calvin after returning.
Calvin and Dave ended their June 9, 2023 conversation warmly, wishing each other safe travels and saying they would see each other soon.
On June 16, 2023, Calvin had a minor car accident; Calvin described it as upsetting, but no one was hurt.
On June 21, 2023, Calvin was dealing with insurance and car repairs after the June 16 accident, which took substantial time and energy.
A photo Calvin shared on June 21, 2023 showed a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk.
By June 21, 2023, Calvin's insurance process was complete despite being slow and involving extensive paperwork, and Calvin was having the damaged car repaired.
Calvin was eager to drive the repaired car again.
A photo Calvin shared on June 21, 2023 showed a tow truck parked in a parking lot.
On June 21, 2023, Calvin said it took one week to sort out the car accident, insurance, and repair arrangements. Calvin had worried about the cost, but said the expense was not too bad.

On June 21, 2023, Calvin shared a photo from the auto repair shop showing a man working on a car inside a garage. Calvin identified the man as the mechanic repairing Calvin's car and said the mechanic was knowledgeable and doing his best to get the car running again.

On June 21, 2023, Calvin felt much more confident and excited about the car repair because Calvin trusted the mechanic's expertise, and Calvin was excited to show off the repaired car and drive again.
On June 21, 2023, Calvin shared a photo taken from Calvin's living room showing a view of a small town with a mountain in the background.
On June 21, 2023, Calvin said the living-room photo showing a small town and mountains was taken in a small town in Japan, and he described the mountain view as unbelievably stunning.
On June 21, 2023, Dave thought the view in Calvin's photo was amazing and said he had never seen anything like it before.
On June 21, 2023, Dave asked Calvin whether Calvin had already visited the small town in Japan shown in the photo.
Calvin has not yet visited the small Japanese town with the stunning mountain view, but Calvin plans to visit it after Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean ends.
Calvin is excited to see the snowy mountain peak in person after the tour with Frank Ocean and shared a photo showing a person skiing on a snowy mountain.
Calvin has never tried skiing, although Calvin thinks skiing looks like a lot of fun and might try it someday.
Dave said the skiing scene looked awesome and asked Calvin whether Calvin had ever tried skiing.
Calvin may try skiing once in the future, despite having no previous skiing experience.
Calvin asked Dave whether anything new was happening in Dave's daily routine.
On June 21, 2023, Dave told Calvin that Dave had recently joined a rock band and had been practicing guitar.
On June 21, 2023, Dave shared a photograph showing a group of men playing musical instruments together in a room; Dave identified them as the members of his rock band.
Calvin considers playing guitar in a rock band awesome and believes it will bring Dave many emotions.
Dave believes that good company and great music lift the mood and bring many positive emotions.
On June 21, 2023, Dave ended the conversation because he had to leave, and Dave and Calvin agreed to see each other soon and keep in touch.
By July 7, 2023, Calvin's car had been fully repaired after the crash and was running strongly again.
Calvin enjoys cruising around in Calvin's car and considers it the best.
On July 7, 2023, Calvin shared a photograph showing a red sports car parked on the side of a road; the red sports car was Calvin's car.
On July 7, 2023, Dave said Dave had been spending time with friends at parks.
Dave arranged with Dave's friends to take regular walks together in a park.
On 2023-07-07, Dave planned to visit a favorite spot with friends for a regular walk; the spot overlooks a city skyline, river, and boats.
On 2023-07-07, Dave shared a photo showing a city skyline beside a river with boats on the water, apparently at the spot Dave planned to visit with friends.
On 2023-07-07, Calvin said he lives in a Japanese mansion surrounded by an impressive cityscape and enjoys seeing city lights from its windows.
On 2023-07-07, Calvin shared a photo taken from the backyard of his Japanese mansion showing a boat docked in a canal at sunset.
On 2023-07-07, Calvin shared a photo of the front part of his Japanese mansion, showing a large house with many windows and lights.
Calvin was looking forward to trying Japanese food and experiencing Japanese culture during his Japan visit.
Dave has never been to Japan, but Dave is eager to visit someday to experience Japan's atmosphere, food, technology, culture, and music.
Dave is especially interested in Japanese music and said he is hooked on it.
Calvin was working on music collaborations with Japanese artists and was excited to hear the finished results.
Calvin is working on music collaborations with various artists, including Japanese artists, and plans to share audio clips with Dave when the music is ready.
Dave thinks Calvin's collaborations with different artists to create something unique and special sound amazing, and Dave is eager to hear the finished music.
On July 7, 2023, Calvin thanked Dave for his help, said the music would be awesome, and ended the conversation to return to work. Dave told Calvin not to overwork himself and wished Calvin safety.

On 2023-07-21, Dave returned from a road trip with friends during which they explored stunning countryside, drove along winding roads, enjoyed scenic views, and talked together. Dave described the trip as a refreshing break from corporate work and said it fully recharged him.
Dave loves cars and feels especially connected to his passion when driving on winding roads and taking in countryside views.
Dave said reconnecting with his passion reminded him why he is passionate about what he does and made the long hours of his work feel worthwhile.
On 2023-07-21, Dave shared a photograph showing a person riding a motorcycle down a dirt road in a scenic countryside setting. The conversation does not establish whether the rider was Dave.
On 2023-07-21, Calvin responded warmly to Dave's road-trip update and said that getting away from work to relax on twisty roads sounded enjoyable and recharging.
On 2023-07-21, Calvin was asked to share any recent moments that reminded Calvin what Calvin loves, but no answer from Calvin is included in this conversation segment.
Calvin is transforming his Japanese mansion into a recording studio so he can create music with other artists; having a dedicated creative space has been his dream.
On 2023-07-21, Calvin shared a photo showing progress on the Japanese mansion recording studio: a room containing a ladder and another ladder-like structure.
Calvin regards his recording-studio space in the Japanese mansion as a sanctuary that reminds him why he loves music.
Calvin has been experimenting with different music genres and adding electronic elements to his songs, describing the process as self-discovery and growth.

Calvin believes changing musical styles requires balancing loyalty to his established sound with trying new things. He finds switching styles intimidating and difficult, but also exciting and motivating.
Calvin started making music to follow his dreams and feels excited about how far he has come.
Calvin stays motivated by collaborating with other people, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion.
Dave believes that surrounding himself with good vibes and collaborating with others will boost Calvin, and Dave praises Calvin for having achieved a great deal.
Dave told Calvin that Dave is Calvin's biggest fan and encouraged Calvin to keep pushing himself and never lose sight of his goals.
Calvin said that Dave's support means a lot to Calvin and expressed appreciation for Dave's encouragement.
Dave and Calvin plan to chat and catch up again soon.
On August 3, 2023, Calvin had his Ferrari serviced and found the experience stressful because he is emotionally attached to the car.
Dave finds fixing and refurbishing cars therapeutic and fulfilling. Dave developed this hobby while working on cars with his father during childhood.

During one summer of Dave's childhood, Dave and his father restored an old car together. The work was difficult, but Dave felt satisfied and proud when they saw the finished result and knew they had completed it together.
Dave has fond childhood memories of working on cars with his father, and car restoration is associated with closeness, fulfillment, and pride for Dave.
On August 3, 2023, Calvin asked Dave whether Dave had pictures from the summer when Dave and Dave's father restored an old car; no picture was provided in this segment.
On 2023-08-03, Dave shared a photograph showing a man and a child posing together and said it had been a wonderful experience, suggesting the image was a meaningful reminiscence for Dave.
On 2023-08-03, Calvin recalled visiting a Ferrari dealership and seeing many impressive cars. Calvin shared a photograph of his red car lifted in a garage and said he was proud of it.
Calvin views his car as more than a material possession: it represents his hard work and dedication, inspires him, and reminds him to keep pushing when he sees it every day.
On the night of 2023-08-02, Calvin performed with a group of male musicians, whom Calvin praised as great at music; on 2023-08-03, Calvin shared a photograph of the band playing on a lit stage.

Calvin's current goals are to expand his brand worldwide, grow his fanbase, reach more people through his music, make an impact, collaborate with artists from around the globe, and challenge himself to create special music.

Calvin is determined to make his dreams come true and says he will stay focused and continue pursuing them. Dave consistently encourages Calvin and supports his ambitions, and Calvin says Dave's belief and encouragement mean a lot to him.

On 2023-08-11, Dave told Calvin that Dave had been selected for a car modification workshop and wanted to improve his skills and learn something new. Dave shared a photo showing a man standing in front of a car on a lift.
Dave considers learning auto engineering and building a custom car a dream come true because Dave has always wanted to pursue those activities.
Dave has worked on a car by performing engine swaps and suspension modifications, and Dave is currently learning body modifications.
On 2023-08-11, Dave described giving a classic muscle car a modern twist and shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building.

Dave prefers combining a modern vibe with classic muscle-car styling and values small details that make a customized car unique and personalized. Dave views car customization as creating a work of art on wheels and as a way to express Dave's style.
Calvin praised Dave's automotive work, enthusiasm, attention to detail, and hard work, and Calvin expressed excitement about seeing Dave's future projects.

On 2023-08-11, Dave offered to help Calvin with Calvin's music work and shared a photo of Dave's music studio setup, showing a desk with a keyboard, monitor, keyboard pad, and high-quality sound system. Dave said Calvin's songs would sound amazing in the studio.
On 2023-08-11, Calvin said Calvin was very busy with music work but would keep Dave's offer of studio assistance in mind. Calvin intended to continue working hard and making music.
Dave and Calvin encourage each other's creative pursuits: Calvin supports Dave's automotive projects, while Dave offers Calvin help with music production and studio work.
On August 14, 2023, Dave attended a car workshop in San Francisco, where he explored car restoration and learned about different restoration techniques.
Dave found the San Francisco car workshop cool, inspiring, and motivating; he was impressed by the passion and dedication of the people there and values opportunities to learn and grow.
Calvin thought Dave's experience at the car workshop sounded awesome, cool, and inspiring, and he was glad Dave found something that genuinely motivated him.
On August 14, 2023, Dave asked Calvin what Calvin had been doing lately.

Calvin toured with a well-known artist and described performing for audiences and connecting with them as an unreal, amazing experience. The tour ended with a show in Japan, after which Calvin explored a new place that felt like a dream come true.
Calvin performed a show in Tokyo, Japan, where the audience enthusiastically sang along while Calvin performed one of Calvin's songs. Calvin described the moment as magical and awesome.
Calvin shared a photograph from the Tokyo concert showing a crowd of people at a concert with their hands raised in the air.
Calvin loved seeing the crowd engaged at the Tokyo concert and said that moments when Calvin's art brings joy to others make Calvin proud, motivated, and passionate about spreading joy through art.

Dave praised Calvin's Tokyo performance and the energetic concert crowd, saying that it was great when Calvin's passion brought joy to other people. Calvin then asked Dave how Dave's automotive project was progressing.

On August 14, 2023, Dave shared a photo of the car he is restoring; the photo showed a car with a broken engine sitting in the woods. Dave said the project was progressing from a beat-up mess toward a beautiful finished car.
Dave planned to have the car restoration finished by September 30, 2023, acknowledging that it would require substantial elbow grease but would be worth the transformation.
Calvin believed Dave's restored car would look amazing and praised Dave's serious talent, enthusiasm, and hard work.
Calvin told Dave that Calvin's support meant a lot to Dave, that Calvin was always there for Dave, and encouraged Dave to keep growing and finish the restoration.
On August 18, 2023, Dave had a card night with his friends, where they laughed and had a great time. A shared photo showed a group of men sitting around a table playing cards.
Calvin secured a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean, which Calvin described as a dream come true after working hard toward it.
Calvin feels extremely happy and believes his continued collaboration with Frank Ocean is the result of his hard work finally paying off.
Calvin met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo, and the two connected over shared ideas. They later arranged a meeting and recorded a song together in the studio at Calvin's mansion.
On August 22, 2023, Calvin described Tokyo as buzzing with energy and said the lively festival crowd felt like fuel for his soul.
On August 22, 2023, Calvin shared a photo showing a crowd of people sitting on grass at night during the Tokyo festival.
On August 22, 2023, Calvin said playing at the Tokyo festival was a dream come true; he described the crowd as super upbeat and said everyone felt connected.
Dave reacted enthusiastically to Calvin’s Tokyo festival experience and asked what playing at the festival was like.
On August 22, 2023, Calvin told Dave that someone noticed Calvin's performance and Calvin is now working with that person on a collaboration; Calvin did not identify the collaborator.

Calvin said his tour would end soon and that he would be heading to Boston, where Calvin suggested meeting Dave; Dave agreed to meet Calvin in Boston and asked Calvin to share the details when available.
On August 21, 2023, Calvin and Calvin's friends recorded a podcast discussing the rapidly evolving rap industry.
Calvin told Dave that Calvin would notify Dave when the podcast discussing the rapidly evolving rap industry had been uploaded; Dave said he was looking forward to listening.
On August 31, 2023, Dave asked Calvin how the end of Calvin's tour had been and shared a photo showing a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air.

On August 31, 2023, Calvin said that Calvin's tour had been amazing and that Calvin had been energized by the audience. Calvin said a shared photo captured how Calvin felt and described the experience as an amazing time; the photo showed a crowd watching a concert with a large screen.
On August 31, 2023, Calvin said performing on a big stage had been a dream come true.
On August 31, 2023, Calvin described the energy while performing on a big stage as incredible and said Calvin felt on top of the world; Calvin also called the experience seriously surreal.
On August 31, 2023, Dave congratulated Calvin on achieving an awesome moment and said Calvin's big-stage performance must have been an incredible experience.

On 2023-08-26..2023-08-27, Calvin started shooting a video for Calvin's new album in Miami, using an awesome beach location for epic visuals; Calvin shared a photo showing a camera and a video camera on a beach.
